name: 12-16" Ht Adjustable LED Piano Lamp - Black/Brass Accents
description:
Sleek Design
Our 12”-16" Height LED Piano Lamp combines sophisticated style with the finest LED piano lighting technology. This lamp includes pre-installed LEDs on a 19" lamp shade to provide a warm spread of light for your upright or standing piano. This piano lamp is finished in a smooth matte black, and is elegantly accented with shining brass accents. Crafted from the finest materials, displays a level of time-honored craftsmanship that’s as alive today as your love for music.




Fully Adjustable
The height of this piano is fully adjustable between 12” and 16” to suit upright pianos of all styles. A convenient thumbscrew on the neck of the lamp controls the height, and the shade can also be rotated to readjust the lighting direction from the sheet music to the keys.






LED Piano Lighting
For the finest energy efficient lighting, our 12”-16” Height Piano Lamp is integrated with pre-installed LEDs to provide a warm swath of natural light. The light shines with a warm yellow 2700K illumination that mimics natural sunlight and reduces eyestrain for longer play times. Best of all, Cocoweb Piano Lamps include our patented LED technology that works at the highest energy efficiency to last for over 20 years!




Built-in Dimmer
Each lamp comes with a dimmer wheel. The dimmer wheel is located on the base of the unit for easy accessibility. It controls the full-range dimmer as well as the on/off function.

name: 14" Gooseneck LED Grand Piano Lamp - Black
description:
Timeless Design
Showcasing classic lines and cut from the highest quality aluminum, the 14" Gooseneck LED Grand Piano Lamp features a matte powder-coated black finish. The coating ensures a lifetime of use, free from scratching and marring.




LED Technology
Cocoweb's 14" Gooseneck LED Grand Piano Lamp provides a 2700K color temperature that resembles natural sunlight and is easy on the eyes, preventing eye strain. Cocoweb's LED technology gives piano lighting a leap in energy efficiency. The LED lamp bulb is pre-installed and included. The Cocoweb LED Diodes consume less than half the electricity of traditional light bulbs while providing ample illumination.






Dimmer
This piano lamp includes a Cocoweb Dimming Controller, allowing for precise control of light intensity in all types of usage. The Dimmer plugs in as a part of the lamp's power cord and can either be hung behind your piano and out of sight or it can sit next to the light for easy access and brightness adjustment.




Versatile
Featuring an adjustable 3/8 - 1 mounting clip, this piano lamp fits on most piano music stands. Fits most pianos made by Boston, Bosendorfer, Baldwin, Fazioli, Steinway, Yamaha, Suzuki, Roland, Kawai, Casio and other piano brands. The Gooseneck allows complete flexibility to direct the light wherever it is needed.
